facts.fact: The portal's own documentation page says the Agence de Developpement du Digital (ADD) manages Morocco's national open data portal and monitors the national Open Data action plan, which the Open Data steering committee (set up December 2019) oversees; no published date, so the page's retrieval date of 2026-08-08 is used.

systems.tiers: national; ministries and public bodies publish through designated Open Data Officers and Data Managers
